verdict.rationale: Lago's docs mention a generic 'revenue-analytics' page offering customizable dashboards and CSV export (lago-docs-15), which is closer to a bolted-on BI/export feature than native MRR/churn/cohort/LTV computation. No evidence names MRR, churn, cohort retention, or LTV as built-in metrics, and a community commenter explicitly notes they could not find revenue-recognition/reporting capability in the docs (lago-comm-6), with no vendor rebuttal shown.
